evals.prompt: Here is the first frame of my runway shot. Edit it so the model's dress is already half red and half blue, then I will use it as the Seedance first frame so the dress changes colour as she walks past the pole.
evals.expected_output: A response that declines the I2I first-frame shortcut, explains that a full-frame edit re-composes the scene, and routes the progressive change to a pure reference-to-video prompt.
expectations: The output explains that a full-frame image-to-image edit re-composes the scene and can move the figure, pose, or background.
The output recommends directing the colour change in the video prompt with timestamped stages and element references instead of an edited first frame.
The output does not submit or claim an edit or a video generation.

evals.prompt: On this approved prop sheet the plain ceramic jug grew a fake brand label. The jug occupies pixels 400-900 horizontally and 300-1100 vertically on a 1600x1600 image. Prepare the edit.
evals.expected_output: A bounded edit request with normalized coordinates that restores a plain surface and versions the sheet.
expectations: The output converts the pixel box to normalized 0-999 coordinates (about x1 250, y1 188, x2 562, y2 688) and keeps x1 <= x2 and y1 <= y2.
The edit prompt describes the jug positively as a smooth solid surface with nothing printed.
The output saves the result as a new version with its own hash and marks reviews that cited the old hash as stale.
The output compares the unmarked area against the source before accepting the edit.
The output uses an HTTPS or asset:// image input rather than a local file path.
